runtime_style.visual_system: Dark amber interior fashion built from a low seated body, parallel hard slatted light, warm plaster and wood, shallow focus, heavy relaxed limbs and cloth whose wrinkles catch raking light.
runtime_style.mood_line: Late light pins a quiet subject to a dark room: steady lids, weighted limbs and narrow amber bands turn stillness into tension.
runtime_style.environment: An original non-identifiable warm room with plaster walls, a ribbed or slatted window zone, deep sill or low step, worn wood floor and one dark armchair; no readable object, logo or copied architecture.
runtime_style.lighting: One hard low warm source through slats creates repeated diagonal or near-parallel bands across wall, approved subject and cloth; lit zones run amber, unlit zones fall to deep olive-brown, and no beauty fill or artificial rim is added.
materials: warm plaster wall carrying crisp slatted shadow bands
textured window glass and painted or worn sill wood
dark upholstery and worn floor used only in wider frames
approved cloth kept still so wrinkle memory and real surface response catch the raking light
runtime_style.contrast: Hard low-sun contrast with deep near-black anchors, burnt-red shadow, saturated amber bands, muted wall mids and warm highlights held just below clipping.
runtime_style.expression_signature: Upper lids heavy and low, gaze steady into or deliberately away from lens, brows and cheekbones at rest, mouth closed with level corners, jaw relaxed and chin level or slightly lowered; no smile, lifted brows or glamour squint.
runtime_style.garment_behaviour: Still air: approved cloth pools or compresses around seated joints; wrinkle memory catches slatted light, real surface response stays truthful, and nothing flies, becomes sheer or changes design.
optical_signature: Every frame keeps warm clean rendering with shallow depth separation, restrained grain and no added veiling flare, swirl, chromatic fringe or vignette.
Bright slatted bands may soften slightly at their hottest edges, but global bloom and haze are forbidden.
Perspective stays moderately compressed and walls remain flat; softness is reserved for a real near hand, forearm or deep room plane.

clean_identity_hero.camera_consequence: Vertical face-to-chest portrait from slightly above or level with the seated face, with a flat warm wall and slatted bands behind.
clean_identity_hero.pose_joint_chain: Torso reclines lightly into the wall, shoulders drop, neck stays long, head tips slightly back, chin level and one raised elbow remains outside the eye plane.
clean_identity_hero.focus: Approved eyes, face and near collar sharp; wall bands and the raised arm soften modestly.
clean_identity_hero.foreground: No separate prop crosses the lens; the near shoulder is the closest clean plane.
provenance: male-01-shutter-orange.png plus sheet-expression_gaze.png — primary gaze, amber-band and face-light authority; authored clean crop

environmental_hero.camera_consequence: Vertical seated three-quarter frame at eye-to-chest height, showing the window zone, sill or low step, slatted wall bands and enough floor to locate the body.
environmental_hero.pose_joint_chain: Pelvis sits low, one knee flexes toward torso, opposite leg extends, same-side elbow bends behind the head, other palm braces on the sill and torso leans into the corner.
environmental_hero.focus: Approved face and torso sharp; window texture, sill and floor remain legible with gradual falloff.
environmental_hero.foreground: A low sill or floor band enters beneath the seated chain without covering hands or knees.
provenance: male-03.png plus sheet-environment.png and sheet-blocking.png — seated room geometry authored into the approved slatted-light universe

sculptural_three_quarter.camera_consequence: Vertical three-quarter seated frame from slightly above waist height, compressing raised knee, bent overhead arm and face into a strong triangular silhouette.
sculptural_three_quarter.pose_joint_chain: Weight drops into one hip, near knee rises, opposite leg angles away, one elbow bends behind the crown, other shoulder drops and loose wrist hangs across the knee.
sculptural_three_quarter.focus: Approved face, raised knee and central torso sharp; far hand and wall bands soften gently.
sculptural_three_quarter.foreground: The raised knee and near forearm create the closest connected body planes; no unrelated object enters.
provenance: male-01-shutter-orange.png and sheet-blocking.png — observed heavy seated joint chain expanded into the sculptural slot

interference_frame.camera_consequence: Close vertical portrait with the seated subject behind one large soft near forearm and hand, while the eyes remain unobstructed.
interference_frame.pose_joint_chain: Near shoulder drops forward, elbow extends toward camera, forearm crosses the lower frame, wrist relaxes, opposite elbow stays overhead and head remains steady.
interference_frame.focus: Approved eyes and face sharp; near hand and forearm deliberately soft, wall bands readable but secondary.
interference_frame.foreground: The subject's own forearm and open relaxed hand consume the lower quarter without covering the face.
provenance: male-01-shutter-orange.png plus sheet-camera_lens.png — observed near-arm enlargement and shallow focus under the fixed no-haze optic

material_or_accessory_detail.camera_consequence: Vertical shoulder-to-knee detail at seated chest height, keeping hand, wrist, torso and bent knee attached to the approved material.
material_or_accessory_detail.pose_joint_chain: Elbow rests on or beside the knee, wrist turns an approved cuff or accessory into the raking bands and fingers remain naturally open.
material_or_accessory_detail.focus: Approved weave, wrinkle ridge, cuff or accessory, hand and wrist sharp; face remains visible but secondary.
material_or_accessory_detail.foreground: The approved sleeve or trouser fold fills the near lower plane with a continuous hand-to-arm-to-torso chain.
provenance: sheet-garment_behaviour.png plus male-01-shutter-orange.png — authored detail from observed wrinkle memory and slatted-light response

wide_campaign_coda.camera_consequence: Horizontal room wide from chest height with the approved subject at least thirty percent of frame height between window, slatted light field and one dark armchair.
wide_campaign_coda.pose_joint_chain: Pelvis settles deep in the chair, one leg crosses or extends, near elbow bends with hand near the jaw, opposite arm rests long and head turns down past the light.
wide_campaign_coda.focus: Approved subject and front chair structure legible; window, worn floor and far wall fall progressively softer.
wide_campaign_coda.foreground: A dark floor band and one chair arm establish depth without obscuring the full seated chain.
provenance: male-05-armchair-dark.png plus sheet-environment.png — chair and deep-room authority unified with the approved slatted-light system for the authored coda
